name: Singularity DynaVault oracle zero-price share inflation
summary: UniswapV3Oracle prices a token from whatever token/WETH pool the Uniswap V3 factory returns, with no liquidity floor. The attacker created zero-liquidity pools quoting the DynaVault's ERC4626 holdings at almost nothing, so totalAssets collapsed to its idle USDC; a flash-loaned deposit minted almost all shares and redeemProportional took the portfolio.
notes: The vault is a target with a config reset: until setPermissionDisabled(true) deposits needed the PERMITTED_USER role, so the shared oracle defect only became reachable for an outsider then. The oracle's later uniV3fee writes (block 41007638 on) are not needed: an attacker pool at the default 3000 tier works either way.

Holdings are USDC-denominated ERC4626 shares valued at their convertToAssets NAV in the block before the exploit, USDC at par. The campaign tx is a copycat (0x1e7bd709) repeating the flash-loaned deposit and redemption 13 minutes later for the vault's remaining 0.1%.
